conditions.source: Frozen source identity; clean pushed main before publication
conditions.package: Exact source/tree/ZIP parity and bounded permitted files
conditions.metadata: Synchronized version, readme, generated contracts and translations
conditions.standards: Syntax, WPCS, PHP compatibility, complexity and regression tests
conditions.requests: Method, capability and nonce before administrative payloads
conditions.validation: Bounded exact input schemas; no copied or forwarded superglobals
conditions.escaping: Final-context escaping and reviewed non-HTML protocol emitters
conditions.wordpress_apis: Prepared SQL, WP_Filesystem, Transients API and safe core includes
conditions.assets_licenses: Readable public sources, build instructions and compatible licenses
conditions.standalone: All Core functionality works without licensing or an external updater
conditions.services_consent: Documented services, appropriate consent and optional public credits
conditions.plugin_check: Current pinned checker, standard and experimental runtime checks, no findings
conditions.runtime: Exact ZIP passes supported runtimes, browser, lifecycle and multisite checks
conditions.agent_review: Specific current evidence closes all policy and reviewer obligations
conditions.website_prepared: Exact source commit/channel imported; guides reviewed; website tests, build and verification passed
conditions.website_live: Published tag deployed to cybermaps.dev; production contracts, downloads and changelog verified
conditions.remote_capabilities: Only reviewed owned read-only MCP resources/search; no generic ability bridge, custom MCP authentication, or remote mutation abilities; dependency/migration/negative runtime evidence required
conditions.output_buffer_ownership: No shipped PHP buffer mutation calls/imports; native caller-ownership cases and registered report stylesheet checks pass with retained granular evidence
conditions.sitemap_ownership: Core sitemaps are replaced only while Cybermaps actively manages XML and owns the redirect; native filter/private-site decisions, opt-out handover, static ownership cleanup, per-site isolation and fresh HTTP enable/disable/restore cases must pass
conditions.stable_presentation: Current benefit-led stable wording, accurately disclosed optional features, Directory images with provenance and matching captions, exact-candidate screenshots and evidence-backed responsive/keyboard/zoom/empty/error/save/destructive visual review
conditions.native_updates: Exact candidate passes real dashboard and WP-CLI updates from the reviewed latest-stable baseline on single sites and networks (the first stable launch uses the explicit beta baseline); stable basename/native updates and settings, tables, cron, rewrites, files and activation are preserved; public WordPress.org update verification follows SVN publication
conditions.everyday_workloads: Complete 1000-item and 10000-item sitemap, report and full static-publication workloads in all four cache configurations within existing resource limits; controlled reviewed-baseline comparison, raw evidence and truthful larger-corpus limitations
conditions.wordpress_distribution: One atomic SVN release from frozen bytes and reviewed separate Directory assets; immutable new tag, exact downloaded file parity, verified listing/artwork and native update before public GitHub/website launch; ambiguous writes inspected before retry
conditions.release_channels: Stable is the default; beta is explicit and cannot reach WordPress.org or replace stable production docs; exact source, metadata, assets and receipts stay consistent across resumable channels
